completion_decisions: Use radius 20 m and retain the conflicting paper label in the fact declaration.
Expose both Case C stopping profiles without silently choosing one.
Use independent islands without invented migration.
Use counter-based random events and ordered commits for worker-count-independent scientific results.

paper.authors: S.A. Grady and M.Y. Hussaini and M.M. Abdullah
paper.title: Placement of Wind Turbines Using Genetic Algorithms

paper_source_conflicts: Table 1 labels a 40 m rotor radius while the stated five-diameter 200 m grid and cited model imply a 40 m diameter; the implementation registers radius 20 m.
The abstract reports 2500 generations for Case C while the experiment body reports 1000; both profiles are exposed and the body is primary.
No author implementation was located and island migration is not specified.

scope.claim_boundary: paper-equation academic declared reproduction with explicit conflict profiles; no author-source or author-exact numerical claim

constraints_and_repair.resolution: one turbine at most per grid cell; empty layouts repair to one deterministic cell

decision_variables.resolution: 100 binary occupancy variables on a 10 by 10 grid

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: two-word packed binary layout; row-major cell-center decoder

initialization.resolution: deterministic counter-RNG Bernoulli binary population partitioned into 20 islands

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: objective, power, turbine count, physical FES, stage timings, and scientific hash

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize farm cost divided by expected farm power

paper_native_cases.resolution: Grady Cases A, B, C-body-1000 and C-abstract-2500 registered as switchable problems

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: A and B use 1800600 FES; C exposes body-primary 600600 and abstract-alternative 1500600 FES

update_order.resolution: within-island roulette selection, uniform crossover, bit mutation, elitist ordered commit; no invented migration

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Jensen wake with 20 m rotor radius, analytic rotor overlap, root-sum-square deficits, registered power and cost curves

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: paper Cases A, B, and normalized C joint direction-speed weights
